author: Eke-Eke (Genesis Plus GX); chimera port by Sergio Martin
_memoryLayoutMiB_note: sbrk, sealed, invis, plain, mmap. The core's state lives in the ELF's own sections (cart.rom is a 32MB static); the invisible heap carries only the 2MB render bitmap and the 1MB MCD saveram compose buffer.

video._comment: buffer CAPACITY; the live size comes from GetVideoWidth/Height per frame. Virtual dims are the NTSC 320x224 picture at its 292px aspect-corrected width.

input.name: SG-1000 Controller
input._comment: index order is the wire format for this system's controller (the author's BizHawk definition): the console buttons, then its pads. The guest picks this wire from the machine it booted, so a package and its core always agree.

settings.name: systemHardware
settings.description: Which console this package's machine is. Each package ships one console, so this is pinned to it: the emulator picks its hardware from this, never from a file name (the frontend mounts a cartridge under a fixed name with no extension).

settings.name: port1
settings.description: What is plugged into the console's first controller port.

settings.name: port2
settings.description: What is plugged into the console's second controller port.

settings.name: region
settings.description: The emulated console's region. Many games run on several regions and behave differently across them; some require one.

settings.name: forceVDP
settings.description: Overrides the video mode to 60Hz (NTSC) or 50Hz (PAL) regardless of the console region.

settings.name: lowPassRange
settings.description: Low pass filter strength in 0.16 fixed point (26214 = 40%). Only active when the filter is lowPass.

settings.name: lowFreq
settings.description: Only active when the filter is threeBand.

settings.name: highFreq
settings.description: Only active when the filter is threeBand.

settings.name: lowGain
settings.description: Percent. Only active when the filter is threeBand.

settings.name: midGain
settings.description: Percent. Only active when the filter is threeBand.

settings.name: highGain
settings.description: Percent. Only active when the filter is threeBand.
